title: Amajwi y’abiyeguriye Imana ari iruhande rw’umuhanuzi
intro: Mu gihugu cya kure, intumwa y’icyubahiro yahuye n’ibyago bikomeye by’abategetsi b’icyo gihe. Nyamara itsinda rito ry’abantu biyeguriye Imana ryari rihagaze iruhande rw’uyu mugaragu wa Allah, rishishikajwe no gusubiza umuhamagaro w’Imana. Ukwizera kwabo kudacogora kwari gucamo ibice igihugu gikomeye kandi amaherezo kukanesha imbaraga z’abatemera Imana.
clues: Twari itsinda rito ryiyeguriye Imana, ryunze ubumwe mu kwizera no mu ntego.
Twari duhagaze iruhande rw'intumwa y'icyubahiro yanzwe n'abategetsi bakomeye bo mu gihugu cyabo.
Ubwo iyi ntumwa yabazaga iti: 'Ni bande bamfasha mu nzira ya Allah?' twasubije tudashidikanya.
Twasabye iyi ntumwa gushaka ibirori biturutse mu ijuru kugira ngo biduhe icyizere mu mitima yacu.
Mu bantu bo muri icyo gihe, bamwe bemeraga binyuze mu butumwa bwacu abandi baranze binangiye, ariko Allah yakomeje abizera.
Turi Hawwariyyun — abigishwa b’indahemuka ba Isa, batsindishijwe n’inkunga ya Allah.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
